g.text: Each bar: a deep model's WMAPE or |bias| minus LightGBM's on the same series and weeks. Left of 0 = better than LightGBM.
Grey band = single-seed noise. "Best of 5 ES" = best of 5 early-stopping settings, picked with hindsight.
